first_attempt.cause: Harness assumed genesis --timestamp 0 also fixed mined block timestamps. Actual deploymentTimestamp was1, causing expected Expired rejections for the first two expiry calls rather than the earlier timestamp-zero errors. All8 Factory constructor checks had already passed.

final_attempt.clock_control: Explicit successful anvil_setBlockTimestampInterval(0), all deployed block timestamps asserted0

limits: Exact original creation bytecode, constructor calldata and supplied call input/value/origin are replayed; no patched contract is substituted.
Creation origins are funded and impersonated only within the disposable child Anvil; other call origins are funded for eth_call. Symbolic initial-state balances/storage are not fully injected.

Expiry eth_call targets are rebound to the corresponding newly deployed local instances under a 20000000 gas cap. The pinned Anvil default chain/fork and prior deployment nonce state are used; this is not an exact symbolic-world recreation.
The8 Factory creation calls fail before later sequence steps. The experiment does not execute those impossible later steps or disprove the genuine token-freeze/fee-waiver conditions.
Timestamp-zero Anvil is a controlled local counterexample, not acceptance of a real chain clock or production timelock policy.
Executed harnesses are archived verbatim with their session-specific tool/report paths. The original failed assumption is retained; no analyzer outcome or required gate changed.
input_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 hexadecimal strings, not decoded bytes
